note: AP2 is an optional UCP extension, dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate (dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate before v2026-08-25). UCP places the merchant authorization, checkout mandate and payment mandate; AP2 defines the formats. Live use inside UCP is unverified; Google says Gemini uses AP2 for its Google Pay purchases outside any documented UCP flow (2026-11-17).
Google originated both, but they no longer share a steward: Google donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance on 2026-04-28, while UCP stays under its own Governing Council.

Both specify agent checkout with the merchant as merchant of record; no bridge or mapping is specified. Stripe co-develops ACP and sits on UCP councils. OpenAI's plugin guide of 2026-11-13 shows a reference checkout that follows UCP's field names and enums rather than ACP's, naming neither protocol.

The network_token credential type (number, cryptogram, eci_value, token_requestor_id) can carry network tokens in general; no Agent Pay integration is documented, and Google surfaces use Google Pay PAN_ONLY.
Both use RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and UCP added optional Web Bot Auth interop; the UCP spec never names TAP and no bridge is documented. Visa is a listed endorser.
No documented relation in the spec; Stripe's UCP integration is a payment handler for tokenized methods, not MPP.
